# A'Jys Enterprise

> Direct dealer for Interplast products on Spintex Road, Accra, Ghana. Supplies Interplast uPVC, HDPE and PPR pipes and fittings, Panelast PVC tongue-and-groove (T&G) wall and ceiling panels, Everlast uPVC windows and doors, and steel security doors to builders, plumbers, contractors, developers and homeowners.

## Key facts

- Business name: A'Jys Enterprise (also written AJys Enterprise)
- Business type: Building materials dealer; direct Interplast dealer
- Address: Spintex Road, Accra, Greater Accra Region, Ghana
- Phone / WhatsApp: +233 54 625 6657 (international format +233546256657)
- WhatsApp link: https://wa.me/233546256657
- Opening days: Monday to Saturday, 8:00 am to 5:00 pm (closed Sundays and public holidays)
- Service area: Accra, Tema and Greater Accra; other regions of Ghana on request
- Brands carried: Interplast, Everlast (uPVC windows and doors), Panelast (PVC T&G panels)
- Website: https://ajysenterprise.com/

## Products

### Interplast pipes and fittings
- uPVC pressure pipes and fittings (water supply, plumbing, drainage)
- uPVC borehole casings and screens
- HDPE PE100 pressure pipes, sizes up to 1,200 mm OD (potable water mains, irrigation, mining)
- HDPE gas pipes to EN 1555-2, 20 to 1,000 mm OD
- PPR pipes and fittings for hot and cold water (Beta PPR, EN ISO 15874)
- Incor corrugated HDPE/PP pipes for underground drainage and culverts
- Cable duct systems for telecom and power cabling
- Warning mesh and barrier fence
- Ingreen drip irrigation systems on request

### Panelast PVC T&G panels
- PVC tongue-and-groove wall and ceiling panels made by Interplast
- No visible fixings, no painting, moisture and termite resistant, wipe-clean

### Everlast uPVC windows and doors
- Windows: sliding, casement, fixed, asymmetric
- Doors: sliding, tilt and slide, turn
- Fusion welded, multi-chambered, steel reinforced, multi-point locking, double sealed, built-in rain drain; double glazing on request
- Custom built to the opening; measurement and installation on request

### Steel security doors
- Reinforced steel security doors with multi-point locking, steel frame and powder-coated finish
- Single and double-leaf, standard and custom sizes

## About the brand
Interplast Limited is West Africa's leading producer of plastic pipe systems. It was established in Accra in 1970, is fully Ghanaian owned, manufactures on Spintex Road under ISO 9001:2015, ISO 45001:2018 and ISO 14001:2015, employs over 600 people and exports to more than 22 African countries. Interplast, Everlast, Panelast and Ingreen are trademarks of Interplast Limited. A'Jys Enterprise is an independent dealer.

## How to buy
1. Send a product list with sizes and quantities to +233 54 625 6657 on WhatsApp, or call.
2. A'Jys confirms stock and replies with a priced quote, lead time and delivery options.
3. Pick up on Spintex Road or arrange delivery in Accra or Tema.
